data.title: 摩根 · 雨之魔女森林
data.description: 【摩根 · 雨之魔女森林】细雨初歇的妖精森林里，年轻的梣披着蓝袍提着法杖走过湿润的苔径，兜帽下的银发沾着水珠，眼神温柔而辽远——「雨会停，而路还很长。」
data.action: 雨停后披蓝色兜帽袍持木杖走过湿苔路径，另一手提稳袍摆
data.camera: full-body side view, walking boots and wet moss path visible
data.promptProse: Aesc walks the wet moss path after rain, one hand on her wooden staff and the other lifting a small portion of her closed blue robe above the ground. Its raised hood shelters silver hair, droplets along the edge. The full-body side view includes sturdy boots and ferns overlapping the path, trees receding beyond. Soft daylight from thinning clouds catches wet moss and robe crests, with gentle shade beneath the hood.
